themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist and right-wing parties in France and the United States are staging high-profile campaign blitzes ahead of major upcoming elections. Marine Le Pen kicked off her French presidential campaign with speeches promoting national renaissance, while Donald Trump and JD Vance are headlining midterm rallies across key US states to energize conservative voters.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen launches her presidential campaign at the party congress in Orléans, leading polls six months out from the vote.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and Vice President JD Vance host midterm campaign rallies across swing states to mobilize the GOP base.

themes.title: Culture War Pushback Against Progressive Symbols
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures in Sweden and the United States are targeting progressive social policies and symbols in favor of traditional national identity. Sweden Democrats in municipal leadership are moving to replace Pride flags with the national flag, while US conservative leaders restrict trans military service and attack sports-related protest movements.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Local SD leadership pushes to ban Pride flags from municipal flagpoles to promote the national Swedish flag.
